items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

ctx.x: It was “Tickle Toe,” it was in Tulsa, and I don’t know he loved to hang around the musicians and everything, so we liked him very much. So Prez wrote a song, and named it “Tickle Toe.”
Can you tell us any other little stories like that around the titles of some of these songs? Cause isn’t there a story about Moose the Mooch? The title of that song?
